title: Ship the HW2 test instructions and a repeatable coverage script
description: User request on 2026-11-08: finish everything for HW2 except writing the report. Part 4 needs the final test suite in the repository with the necessary configuration files and instructions for running the tests and reproducing coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a checkout with a private .env, when scripts/measure-coverage.py runs, then Ruff, the real-service backend suite and Vitest run with the HW2 source scope and the line and branch totals are printed.
Given the development project name ara, when the script is asked to use it, then it refuses without running anything.
Given the README, when a reader follows its test section, then it names where each suite lives and how to install, run and reproduce coverage.
verification: Test first: tests/infrastructure/test_measure_coverage.py failed before the script existed (3 failures, 1 error), then 4 passed. End-to-end run of the script on the unchanged final tests in ara-hw2-r1-test: Ruff passed; backend 1374 passed, 21 xfailed in 327.26 s; 8658/9050 lines (95.67%), 2054/2378 branches (86.38%); frontend 803 passed in 95 files, 3189/3323 lines, 3485/3968 branches. These counts equal the frozen ARA-122 measurement. The frontend percentages then switched to Vitest's own figures, which truncate (95.96%, 87.82%). Infrastructure 50 OK: the 46 measured plus these 4, which test the script and are outside both coverage denominators. No application source or application test changed.
